title: Prescription Drug Addiction (Benzodiazepines, Sleeping Pills & Other Dependence-
sourceFile: Prescription drug addiction (e.g., benzodiazepines, sleeping pills).pdf
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from prescription drug addiction,
including dependence on benzodiazepines (such as anti-anxiety medications) and sleeping pills. Recovery is
a journey of restoring physical health, emotional balance, and inner peace. These affirmations encourage
patience, resilience, self-compassion, and hope while complementing professional medical care, supervised
tapering (when appropriate), counseling, and peer support.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
If you are recovering from dependence on benzodiazepines or certain sleeping medications, never
stop taking them abruptly without medical guidance. A healthcare professional can help you develop
a safe tapering plan, as sudden discontinuation can cause serious withdrawal symptoms. Recovery is
strongest when it combines self-compassion, healthy daily practices, and appropriate medical and
emotional support.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by prescription drug dependence or my past. I am defined by my courage to heal,
my strength to persevere, and my commitment to living a healthy, balanced life. Every day I choose
recovery, I restore my body, renew my mind, and strengthen my spirit. One day at a time, I am
creating a future filled with freedom, peace, hope, and lasting wellness.
